facts.fact: Communications minister Sam George, reported by Accra Posts, describes Ghana's AI strategy as a ten-year plan with measurable targets and priority sectors of agriculture, health, education and government services.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations

facts.fact: The government plans a national AI compute centre, whose first phase has secured US$250 million in funding, per minister Sam George.
Minister Sam George said an AI boot camp was held for cabinet ministers and AI training with UNDP and UNESCO is beginning for chief directors and directors.
